title: Skill Definition Schema
description: Schema for validating Claude Code SKILL.md YAML frontmatter fields

description.description: Clear description of what the skill does and when to invoke it

user_invocable.description: Whether users can invoke directly via /skill-name

tools.description: Tools this skill is allowed to use

allowed-tools.description: Comma-separated list of allowed tools (alternative to tools array)

best_practices.description: Key best practices for this skill

verified.description: Whether the skill has been verified by the creator/updater workflow

lastVerifiedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the skill was last verified or updated

source.description: Origin of skill (e.g., mcp-npm, custom, converted)

original_server.description: Original MCP server name if converted from MCP tool

disable-model-invocation.description: If true, the skill content is injected directly without LLM invocation

frontmatter.description: v3.1.0: machine-parseable metadata block per design.md dual-layer pattern. Agents can inspect this without reading full prose.

triggers.description: Patterns that should invoke this skill

output_schema_ref.description: Pointer to schema defining this skill's structured output, if any

token_budget.description: Estimated token cost for invoking this skill

requires_skills.description: Skills this one depends on (resolved by skill index)
